Kuryer ombori kerak emas — buyurtma uyingizgacha keladi. ✅ Afzalliklari • Yetkazuvchi — Meest, to'liq kuzatuv bilan • 30 $ dan yuqori buyurtmaga yetkazish bepul (vaqtinchalik aksiya) • Visa va Mastercard bilan to'lov ⚠️ Bilib qo'ying • Meest cheklovi: bitta posilka 185 $ va 11 kg gacha • BAD normasi: 10 xil nomgacha, jami 3 kg, har nomdan 1 qadoq • Kuryer uchun oylik bojsiz norma — 200 $, oydagi barcha posilkalar qo'shib hisoblanadi 💡 Savatni 185 $ dan oshirmang va bir xil mahsulotdan 2 ta olmang. 🔗 iHerb: O'zbekistonga yetkazish shartlari 📲 Boshqa do'konlar — ilovada 📄 BAD normasi: VM 244-son qarori, 1-ilova (lex.uz) ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #dokon
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#dokon".
2) Center: an open matte cardboard parcel box with three supplement bottles (white with indigo caps) and a small green leaf peeking out; a thin dotted route line arcs from the box to a tiny location pin. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of leaf green (#16A34A); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "iHerb O'zbekistonga yetkazadi"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Ekspeditorsiz, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: iHerb sahifasida boj matni noaniq yozilgan («month calendar quarter») — biz VM 244 dagi oylik 200 $ normaga tayandik. Uzcard/Humo bilan to'lov tekshirilmagan — postda faqat Visa/Mastercard yozildi.
